artifact: CityMETER School — 3D-first, district-first map of recorded students and school records across Thailand, with school groups and affiliations, grades, published tuition, ONESQA results, rail context from the same registry, a comparison set per school and, on the third measure, the learning services of the OPEC nonformal register (0.2.0)
locationIntelligenceProfile: applied for students: li.supply (location-intelligence-profile-lds-0.9.7-r1, sha256 5d4856041709735d3a04d4a510a88b551df86c211fdcab8a0707e8fe7c9efc3b; baseDocument d3085cbc…96) — students recorded are a served quantity (กำลังให้บริการที่มีอยู่), evidence state unverified (roster, not field-verified); records use the base count family

fontRoles.navigation: Material Symbols Rounded approved nav-7 subset; FILL 0 / wght 300 / GRAD 0 / opsz 24
fontRoles.pictograms: Material Symbols Rounded 34-glyph pictogram subset built from the same source font (4892 B, sha256 0c18b9ac…): area, province, segment, ai, streetview, maps, building, school, students (groups), teacher (co_present), classroom (meeting_room), level (stairs), fee (payments), quality (verified), programme (menu_book), history (trending_up), aff (account_tree), closed (event_busy), rail (train), compare (compare_arrows), terrain facts sea, elevation, relief, forest, and rank, date, distance, construction, dataset, learning (auto_stories), tutor (edit_note), language (translate), arts (palette), child (child_care); owner test exception 2026-10-22 (Hotel), school glyphs 2026-11-05, learning glyphs 2026-11-06; no star glyph

colors.applied: assets/theme.css — foundation pairs, semantic states, map roles, dataState (noData, zero), categorical series 1–10 (landometer-series-10-v8 soft fill + ink), count classes, basemap-only tokens
colors.analytical: js/scales.js — li.supply for students (scaleVersion 671112f34b878219faf90fb3fd07cc05a919c134d798ff40fbc8ab278273c497) and count for records and learning records (4ff5c1fb4be71ecd13c48685b38371b528bcd4ce369ce964a75354c2eb4d0980); exact 41-sample LUTs; identical HEX on both themes; all 41 samples by rank among the measured nonzero values (buildRamp; owner standing rule “Color scale ขอให้ใช้ 41 scales ตาม LDS เสมอ”), legend with every sample and value ticks; numbers on low-contrast samples on a plate; a district whose records all have unknown students is no_data (hatch) under students
colors.categorical: js/cues.js — school group id → series (public 1 circle, private 2 square, international 3 triangle, local 4 diamond, vocational 5 cross, nonformal 7 hexagon, other 9 dash, childcare 10 plus); no star
colors.status: no status pills: every row is a roster record (not field-verified), said once in the provenance clause; a closure notice is a dated chip
colors.reportedDifference: LDS analytical scale records list dark noData #3B4849 / zeroOutline #BAC6C0, while machine.tokens.dataState lists dark #404844 / #93A398; the map follows the EVID-05 treatment (dataState), as in Restaurants and Pharmacy, and the difference stays reported to the owner
colors.parity: scripts/check-lds-parity.mjs against the LDS base file and the Location Intelligence Profile: 124 checks (handoff/VERIFICATION.md)
colors.notDistributed: full LDS library, the Location Intelligence Profile, other analytical families
colors.context: stations (CityMETER Transit) as quiet rings: card fill + text-secondary stroke, selected = map.selectedStroke with a dashed 500 m radius; size cue of pins by recorded students; foundation fill for ordinal bars (size bands, levels, stations, affiliations, semesters)

firstAha: share of the leading province’s students placed at district level that sit in up to three districts with the most students (never cutting a tie, never every district holding students), the share of students within 500 m of an operating rail station there against the rest of the province (rows with a point; both bases), and the district(s) with the most students outside it; the same with records under the count measure and with learning-service records under the learning measure (records with a published point for the rail bars); computed per selection; the map opens in the 3D city preset with those districts focused automatically and the rest quiet
countingUnit: measure switch: students recorded (คน, default; unknown students counted apart, never 0) or records (แห่ง) or learning-service records (เรียนเสริม · แห่ง; their own rows, never added to the schools); tuition shown per school as announced, with its academic year

focusAndQuiet.implementation: app.js focus modes (auto/explicit/none) and row scopes; map-layers.js filled/quiet/province feature-state; pins.js cue symbols vs grey context dots; massing.js quiet city tier vs rounded focus tier, see-through front buildings in the building view (setScene eye); venue-xray.js draws the building being looked at over everything else; stations.js quiet station rings and the selected station radius; camera.js presets and the building view (fitBuilding, twoPointBearing); provinces.js frames below zoom 8 without a จังหวัด filter

geometryAndMetricContract: one row per symbol, only rows with a point; membership = the production district the source lists the school under (row.admin); totals only (students, records or learning records — a learning record by the register's district code, pinned only where its registry point lies inside that district); outlines per province on demand
accessibility: visible focus on every control including pins, area labels and chart marks
keyboard pin tour (arrow keys) at detail zoom, excluding quiet context dots
roving tablist for the chart views
table equivalent for every map view
categorical shape cues beside colour; text labels in every legend and list
empty, map-failure, frame-failure and load-error paths with actions
Thai labels for the map’s own controls (MapLibre locale)
measure switch as a radio group (arrow keys), its state announced

validation.renderedHarness: Playwright + MapLibre 5.6.2 from the npm package; OpenFreeMap and unpkg blocked in the build container (stub TileJSON with empty tiles: no basemap, no OSM buildings there); 1440×900 and 390×844, light and dark; live walk on GitHub Pages for the real basemap
validation.scope: Applied LDS values, fonts and actual rendered interfaces. No blanket LDS, CVD, native-device or market-completeness claim.

layoutContract.mobilePortrait: full map, five toolbar buttons in one row (วิธีใช้ and Product statement at the top of the sheet); one compact dock at the foot of the map — the Aha finding in two lines with its action, over one legend row (measure switch | level + zero swatch over the 41-sample ramp) — above the attribution while it is open, dropped to the tray once it folds to its (i) button; zoom buttons off on touch phones (pinch; the compass stays); bottom sheet 56% of the screen with a sticky close, opening on the school, building, station or area (Hotel 0.3.5)

mapContract.basemap: generated at runtime by js/shell/map-style.js on https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet with --basemap-* tokens
mapContract.choropleth: li.supply (students) or count (records, learning records), all 41 samples by rank over the measured nonzero values; beneath the basemap’s first line layer; zoom 8–14.5 (8–12.5 in terrain mode, hard switch), the selected จังหวัด from zoom 4; EVID-05 measured / measured_zero (sample 0 + 2 px zero outline) / no_data (students unknown: hatch)
mapContract.provinces: the same measure per province frame below zoom 8 without a จังหวัด filter, outlines to zoom 12, ink-chip labels to zoom 9, panel list
mapContract.symbols: focus rows with a point as cue icons whose area grows with the recorded students (hollow = unknown; a learning record is LDS series 8, a ring at the 200-student size, its label the service pictograms); context rows as grey circles by students, ≤ 6 px radius; HTML pins from zoom 15.5; the pin label is school name · students; stations of CityMETER Transit as quiet clickable rings from zoom 10.5, names from 13.5
mapContract.buildings: per อปท. (Bangkok: เขต) evaluated by the CityMETER · Hotel build: CityMETER Building V4 where it holds ≥ 1.15 × the OSM buildings of the unit, else OSM; every other unit OSM (data/building-units/, scripts/adapt-building-units.py); OSM buildings mapped in parts kept; the attribution names CityMETER Building V4 while drawn
mapContract.buildingView: eye preset corner-on to the building on the least-occluded diagonal, zoom to fit the free part of the map on every way in (js/shell/camera.js#fitBuilding); a station frames its 500 m radius; every school with a point opens it — the building its pin falls in, else the drawn building nearest the pin within 300 m (800 m after one widen) with the pin in the frame (legend “อาคารใกล้หมุด”); choosing a school or a building switches the map to 3D; a shift lens keeps pitch 75 on a phone above the sheet (Hotel 0.3.2)
mapContract.breadcrumb: ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › เขต/อำเภอ with production codes and /D/ deep links, ?d=school
mapContract.symbolSize: area ∝ recorded students (js/model.js#pinRadius, √(students/400), cap 4,000), hollow = unknown students at the 200-student size, quiet context ≤ 6 px radius (Hotel owner rule 2026-11-01)
mapContract.labels: from zoom 12.5: ≤ 9 (phone 5) labels in the central ellipse ranked by students + published tuition percentiles; text only — group cue, one short name (leading โรงเรียน · รร. · ศพด. dropped), students pictogram + count; measured placement off the chrome and the district chips (js/labels.js)
mapContract.terrain: terrain mode at hilly sites (zoom ≥ 12.5, 3D, relief ≥ 30 m in view) and round a building or school being looked at: 3D ground × 1.5 + hillshade in basemap tones; the district fill switches off at 12.5 (hard switch, never a fade); buildings, the x-ray and the building camera stand on the drawn ground (js/shell/terrain.js, js/shell/camera.js)
mapContract.iconFirstText: district chips carry the measure pictogram, the status is a pin + number, legend items are a symbol + 1–2 words; sentences live in titles and accessible names (owner 2026-11-01)
mapContract.water: light water --basemap-water #CFDDE7 (basemap-only, 1.22:1 from the ground) with the water-shore line --basemap-shore #B2C7D6 above the district fill; dark keeps surface.blueTint #18333E (0.3.4, owner “ใน light theme ทำให้ทะเล/water body ดูเหมือนน้ำมากกว่านี้ … แต่ยัง clean and quiet”); the coast line, district outlines and legend separate the sea from low li.supply classes, never the water hue alone
